description:
Use this when the user wants ONE clip of an exact stretch of a video: "clip 1:02:10 to 1:03:00" (3730 to
        3780 seconds), "make a short from that moment", or a match from get_moments. Makes one captioned vertical clip
        of exactly start_seconds to end_seconds (3 seconds to 5 minutes) of project_id (from list_projects), uncut.
        clipping_preset (id or name from list_clipping_presets) applies a saved look; left empty, the user's default
        preset applies, "none" for RipClip's standard look.
        Not for: letting RipClip pick several highlights (find_clips), searching a topic (find_moments) or changing a
        finished clip (edit_clip). Spends Horizon Units for just those minutes: call estimate_hu with the same range as
        range_start / range_end first, show the number and pass the approved amount as max_hu (a higher cost is
        refused; a failed job gives it back). request_key is optional. Returns job_id;
        poll job_status, then list_clips.
name: clip_range
title: Clip a time range
